waveform_checks.scope: Input/image identities and saved metadata only; original PCM/arrays are excluded and no numerical/audio/visual acceptance verdict is replayed.

scope: Archive identity and saved-event/geometry/control audit only. Original MP3/WAV/NPY, runtime/model binaries and raw site dumps are excluded. Saved sample/output hashes are identities, not reconstructed samples. Numerical metrics, sample finiteness, audio quality and audible seams cannot be independently replayed from this media-free archive. Four composite waveform PNGs are derived summaries; raw FFmpeg panels are excluded. Image identities/dimensions and saved assertions do not establish musical acceptance.
